raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.31.0"

recipe:
  name: bipedal-locomotion-framework-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/gbionics/bipedal-locomotion-framework/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: bff3a2691b51dcd0a68fd89578d0aff22bfb0af862ba6e5198393aa0f52f48e1
  patches:
    - patches/0001-prefer-onnxruntime-cmake-config.patch

build:
  number: 2
  # onnxruntime dropped Intel macOS support: https://github.com/conda-forge/onnxruntime-feedstock/pull/206
  skip: osx and x86_64

outputs:
  - package:
      name: libbipedal-locomotion-framework
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: build_cxx.sh
        - if: win
          then: bld_cxx.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - pkgconf
        - ninja
        # YARP idl tools are used in this recipe
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: libyarp
        # PCL requires Qt's tools
        - if: build_platform != target_platform and not ppc64le
          then: qt6-main
      host:
        - eigen
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - idyntree
        - manif
        - libyarp
        - libdinrail
        - tomlplusplus
        - librobometry
        - fmt
        - spdlog
        - cppad
        - manif
        - nlohmann_json
        - libosqp
        - osqp-eigen
        - libmatio-cpp
        - tomlplusplus
        - casadi
        - qhull
        - libopencv
        - pcl
        - onnxruntime-cpp
        - tiny-process-library
        - libtrintrin
        - if: linux
          then: libgl-devel
        # Only required for testing
        - catch2
        # transitive public dependency of pcl
        - vtk
        - liblie-group-controllers
        - libunicycle-footstep-planner
        - if: not win
          then: librealsense
        - if: linux
          then: xorg-libxfixes
        - eigen-abi-devel
      run:
        # manif and eigen are mentioned in the headers so needed when building
        # against libbipedal-locomotion-framework
        - manif
        - eigen
        - liblie-group-controllers
        - tomlplusplus
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libbipedal-locomotion-framework', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        # catch2 is used just for tests, we do not actually link the C++ library
        by_name:
          - catch2
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - BipedalLocomotion/System/Advanceable.h
            - BipedalLocomotion/bindings/System/Advanceable.h
          lib:
            - BipedalLocomotionFrameworkSystem
          # YARP plugins have no corresponding import libraries on Windows.
          files:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - lib/yarp/VectorsCollectionWrapper.so
                - lib/yarp/YarpRobotLoggerDevice.so
            - if: win
              then:
                - Library/lib/yarp/VectorsCollectionWrapper.dll
                - Library/lib/yarp/YarpRobotLoggerDevice.dll
      - script:
          - cmake-package-check BipedalLocomotionFramework --targets BipedalLocomotion::System
        requirements:
          run:
            - cmake-package-check
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - cmake

  - package:
      name: bipedal-locomotion-framework-python
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: build_py.sh
        - if: win
          then: bld_py.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - pybind11
        - pybind11-abi
        - ninja
        - cmake
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: python
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: pybind11
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: pybind11-abi
        # PCL requires Qt's tools
        - if: build_platform != target_platform and not ppc64le
          then: qt6-main
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libbipedal-locomotion-framework', exact=True) }}
        - python
        - pybind11
        - pybind11-abi
        - liblie-group-controllers
        - libyarp
        - libdinrail
        - tomlplusplus
        - idyntree
        - fmt
        - spdlog
        - libopencv
        # Workaround for https://github.com/conda-forge/bipedal-locomotion-framework-feedstock/issues/37
        - libmatio-cpp
        # Workaround for https://github.com/conda-forge/bipedal-locomotion-framework-feedstock/pull/42#issuecomment-1804057782
        - casadi
        - libboost-devel
        - pugixml
        - pcl
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - if: linux
          then: libgl-devel
        - if: linux
          then: xorg-libxfixes
        - icub-models  # Requested just for tests
        - scipy  # Requested just for tests
        - pytest  # Requested just for tests
        - manifpy  # Requested just for tests
        - numpy
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libbipedal-locomotion-framework', exact=True) }}
        - python
        - manifpy
        - idyntree
      ignore_run_exports:
        # icub-models is used just for tests, we do not actually link the C++ library
        by_name:
          - icub-models
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework
          pip_check: true
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pip
        script:
          - if: unix
            then: test $(pip list | grep bipedal_locomotion_framework | tr -s " " | grep $PKG_VERSION | wc -l) -eq 1

  - package:
      name: bipedal-locomotion-framework
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libbipedal-locomotion-framework', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('bipedal-locomotion-framework-python', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libbipedal-locomotion-framework', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.contacts
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.continuous_dynamical_system
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.conversions
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.floating_base_estimators
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.ik
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.math
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.ml
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.parameters_handler
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.planners
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.reduced_model_controllers
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.robot_interface
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.simplified_model_controllers
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.system
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.text_logging
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.tsid
            - bipedal_locomotion_framework.bindings.yarp_utilities
          pip_check: false

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
  summary: Suite of libraries for achieving bipedal locomotion on humanoid robots.
  homepage: https://github.com/gbionics/bipedal-locomotion-framework

extra:
  feedstock-name: bipedal-locomotion-framework
  recipe-maintainers:
    - traversaro
    - GiulioRomualdi
